svg.title: Kyra R1 — glasses, engineering drawing
svg.text: TOUCH STRIP, 3 CH + GUARD, OUTER FACE
CELL, Li-Po 105–160 mAh, ONE PER TEMPLE
1. DIMENSIONS IN MM. SCALE 1:1 ON A3. THIRD-ANGLE PROJECTION.
2. FRAME 50-20-145 NOMINAL. PRODUCTION FORM FACTOR FOR CONTEXT ONLY;
3. NO DISPLAY (D13). NO CAMERA (D14). MICROPHONE POWER IS A
HARDWARE STATE UNDER THE APPLICATION CONTROLLER (D15).
4. HIDDEN LINES SHOW ELECTRONICS INSIDE THE TEMPLES.
5. LEFT TEMPLE MIRRORS THE RIGHT; ITEMS 4-10 CALLED OUT ONCE.
